tasks.short: Discuss vehicle-electronics malfunctions with customers and record the reported symptoms.

steps.what: Retrieve vehicle equipment details and previous fault reports
Confer with customers about malfunction symptoms and circumstances
Clarify the nature of malfunctions and distinguish observations from guesses
Read back the malfunction account to the customer
Write the customer symptom account on the work order

tasks.design: Configure a vehicle-indexed fault view and native symptom fields in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The technician retains the customer conversation and read-back, then separately records symptoms and uncertainties on the work order.
tasks.previous_blocker: Vehicle context must be found and repeated when writing the symptom account.
tasks.enabler_now: Native work-order views and fields can retain vehicle and equipment context.
tasks.still_hard: Intermittent malfunctions and ambiguous descriptions require skilled questioning.
tasks.human_edge: Build an accurate account without presenting the customer's guess as a diagnosis.
tasks.altitude: Make customer-reported symptoms usable for subsequent diagnosis.

reach.learn: Distinguish confirmed symptoms, circumstances and unresolved ambiguity.

evidence.claim: FieldBuddy supplies technician work orders, checklists and asset management; this supports the records capability, not a measured saving for this conversation.
Native fault views and symptom fields could reduce retrieval and repeated writing; the labour estimate is an E1 scenario.

assumptions: The symptom write is part of conferring about the malfunction and is separately priced from listening and clarification.

The technician produces vehicle identifier, equipment, symptom, occurrence conditions, customer-confirmed details and unresolved questions in s5; 14 retained hours include capture and checking. Missing facts stay unknown and require manual clarification.
Try native asset views and symptom fields first; no recording, transcription, automatic diagnosis or new customer portal is proposed.
The read-back check belongs to the actual external communication. The author's internal work-order save has no self-approval gate or separate saving.
unknowns: Whether current work orders already retain equipment context efficiently.
research_questions: Does the native form reduce writing time while preserving intermittent-fault circumstances and uncertainty?

already_counted.description: Capture and check the customer symptom record.

incremental.description: Maintain vehicle fault views and symptom fields.

approvals.approved_version: Exact symptom account and remaining uncertainty read back to this customer; revised statements are checked before communication.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100, R=92, gross=8; upkeep=2 gives central net=6. Conversation and clarification retain all their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record diagnostic test results using checked import and native result fields.

steps.what: Collect diagnostic test outputs and identify the relevant test session
Capture vehicle, equipment and test context for the results record
Map diagnostic output values to the work-order result fields
Write mapped diagnostic results into the internal work-order record
Check recorded results and correct context or import exceptions

tasks.design: Configure a supported diagnostic-file import into the internal service record in {OPS_SYSTEM}. Keep session selection and context capture human, separate mapping from the actual record write, and retain comparison with the source output.
tasks.previous_blocker: The technician reads diagnostic output, aligns values with record fields and rekeys them into a second system.
tasks.enabler_now: Stable export fields and native import mapping can replace the real transfer and rekeying.
tasks.still_hard: The right values attached to the wrong vehicle or test session are still a bad record.
tasks.human_edge: Verify test context and distinguish a measured value from its diagnostic interpretation.
tasks.altitude: Keep a traceable diagnostic record with less duplicate entry.

reach.learn: Read results with their test context and source session.

evidence.claim: FieldBuddy provides asset-linked technician work orders and checklists; the digest does not establish a diagnostic-device connector.
Supported file import could remove manual result-field alignment and rekeying; connector feasibility and labour savings remain an E1 scenario.

assumptions: This scenario has an actual transfer from diagnostic instrument output to a separate service record. Mapping and rekeying are distinct current work; no saving is credited merely to pressing Save.

Producer contract: the diagnostic instrument creates the completed output with session identifier, timestamp, test name, measured value, unit and status during the test. The technician selects and exports it in s1, with all 25 hours counted, then captures vehicle, equipment and work-order linkage in s2, with all ten hours counted.
Unknown vehicle linkage, missing units or an unmapped test prevents s4 writing the affected result and is handled manually in s5. Raw output is retained; the importer does not infer a diagnosis.
Try supported native import first. No external send, equipment actuation, customer report or author self-approval gate is proposed.
unknowns: Export support, stable field identifiers and native service-system import capability.
research_questions: Does import preserve session linkage, units and status on representative outputs and stop ambiguous mappings?

already_counted.description: Compare the result record with source output and resolve exceptions.

incremental.description: Maintain mappings and regression-check device and service-system changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 supported-transfer scenario: B=100, R=50, gross=50; upkeep=8 gives central net=42. Range allows smaller rekeying baselines and unsupported output formats.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep customer understanding and physical diagnosis human while improving symptom and diagnostic records.
reach: Connect the customer's account, the right vehicle and the actual diagnostic output.
role.ambitious_version: A vehicle electronics technician who can trace a repair investigation from customer symptoms to verified test records.

job.title: Electronic Equipment Installers and Repairers, Motor Vehicles
